rv.q: Engrossing and inventive...the comforts of old-fashioned storytelling give way to anxieties about the future.
The extent to which the play is a warning against blindly following charismatic leaders makes it a statement of the obvious.
Experimental exploration of belief and determinism is touched by genius.
The most consistently satisfying work of Tim Crouch I've seen.
Both on and off the page, Total Immediate Collective Imminent Salvation is ethereal and unnerving.
Total Immediate makes for a strange, heady experience.

cn.t: Tim Crouch's innovative theatrical experiment earns acclaim for its inventive format, with audiences and actors reading from books together in an intimate circle, exploring profound themes of loss, faith, and apocalypse through minimalist storytelling.
